item.title: Inject intent gate context into developer retry prompts
item.intent: Developers in retry loops must know that items with intent <20 chars are hard-rejected — this context prevents wasted retries on items that will never pass the gate.
steps: Locate where the orchestrator builds the developer retry prompt context
Add a line to the injected context explaining the intent hard gate (>=20 chars, silently skipped by auto-pick)
This is an orchestrator injection change, not an agent prompt rewrite

acceptanceCriteria.text: Developer context mentions intent minimum length or hard gate
